rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_accident3(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	mm varchar(2)  NOT NULL,
  visit int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  death int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  VEHICLE1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE4 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE5 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE6 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE7 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE8 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE9 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE98 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	VEHICLE99 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,mm),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_accident3 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_accident3
(
SELECT
  @id,a.hospcode
	,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode
	,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
	,month(datetime_serv)  
	,COUNT(DISTINCT a.hospcode,a.pid,a.seq) target
	,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) result

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(1) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(2) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(3) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(4) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(5) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r5
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(6) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r7
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(7) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r8
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(8) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r9
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(9) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r10
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(98) OR VEHICLE IS NULL ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r11
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(VEHICLE in(99) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r12
FROM 
	tmp_accident a LEFT JOIN tmp_service s ON a.HOSPCODE=s.hospcode AND a.PID=s.pid AND a.SEQ=s.seq
INNER JOIN chospital h ON a.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE h.provcode in (@prov_c) AND a.AETYPE in(1) AND a.AEPLACE in(7,8) 
AND DATE_FORMAT(datetime_serv,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY a.hospcode,month(datetime_serv)
);
rows.notice:
- ผู้ป่วยอุบัติเหตุทางถนน ประมวลผลจากแฟ้ม ACCIDENT โดยที่ AETYPE =01 และ AEPLACE เป็น 07,08
- เสียชีวิตเชื่อมโยงกับ SERVICE โดยที่ TYPEOUT เป็น 4,5,6
- ประเภทยานพาหนะที่เกิดเหตุจาก Field VEHICLE

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT concat(sp.hcode) as areacode,ar_name as areamame ,SUM(visit) as visit ,SUM(death) as death ,SUM(VEHICLE1) as VEHICLE1 ,SUM(VEHICLE2) as VEHICLE2 ,SUM(VEHICLE3) as VEHICLE3 ,SUM(VEHICLE4) as VEHICLE4 ,SUM(VEHICLE5) as VEHICLE5 ,SUM(VEHICLE6) as VEHICLE6 ,SUM(VEHICLE7) as VEHICLE7 ,SUM(VEHICLE8) as VEHICLE8 ,SUM(VEHICLE9) as VEHICLE9 ,SUM(VEHICLE98) as VEHICLE98 ,SUM(VEHICLE99) as VEHICLE99  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ampurcodefull as ar_code,ampurname as ar_name,ampurcodefull as l_code FROM campur GROUP BY l_code ORDER BY l_code ) as ar ON left(s.areacode,4)=ar.l_code    INNER JOIN ( SELECT hoscode as hcode,chospital_regis.* FROM chospital_regis INNER JOIN cchangwat ON chospital_regis.provcode=cchangwat.changwatcode WHERE chospital_regis.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND chospital_regis.hdc_regist=1 AND chospital_regis.status ='1' AND (zonecode={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) GROUP BY hoscode ) h ON s.hospcode=h.hcode    LEFT JOIN ccmihosp sp ON sp.hcode=h.hoscode AND sp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode,2) not IN('99') AND b_year IN(SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1))  AND (h.provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (sp.splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep in ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep={{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or {{MINISTRY_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.hoscode={{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) GROUP BY concat(sp.hcode)

service_plan_hospital.query: SELECT concat(h.splevel,'_',h.hcode) as areacode,ar_name as areamame ,SUM(visit) as visit ,SUM(death) as death ,SUM(VEHICLE1) as VEHICLE1 ,SUM(VEHICLE2) as VEHICLE2 ,SUM(VEHICLE3) as VEHICLE3 ,SUM(VEHICLE4) as VEHICLE4 ,SUM(VEHICLE5) as VEHICLE5 ,SUM(VEHICLE6) as VEHICLE6 ,SUM(VEHICLE7) as VEHICLE7 ,SUM(VEHICLE8) as VEHICLE8 ,SUM(VEHICLE9) as VEHICLE9 ,SUM(VEHICLE98) as VEHICLE98 ,SUM(VEHICLE99) as VEHICLE99  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ampurcodefull as ar_code,ampurname as ar_name,ampurcodefull as l_code FROM campur GROUP BY l_code ORDER BY l_code ) as ar ON left(s.areacode,4)=ar.l_code    INNER JOIN ( SELECT hcode as hospcode,hcode,splevel,chospital_regis.* FROM ccmihosp INNER JOIN chospital_regis ON ccmihosp.hcode=chospital_regis.hoscode WHERE byear =SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}},',',-1) AND (splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (ccmihosp.region={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (ccmihosp.chwcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) GROUP BY hcode ) h ON s.hospcode=h.hospcode  WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode,2) not IN('99') AND b_year IN(SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1))     AND (h.provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep in ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep={{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or {{MINISTRY_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.hoscode={{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}='ALL') GROUP BY concat(h.splevel,'_',h.hcode)

hospital.query: SELECT concat(sp.hcode) as areacode,ar_name as areamame ,SUM(visit) as visit ,SUM(death) as death ,SUM(VEHICLE1) as VEHICLE1 ,SUM(VEHICLE2) as VEHICLE2 ,SUM(VEHICLE3) as VEHICLE3 ,SUM(VEHICLE4) as VEHICLE4 ,SUM(VEHICLE5) as VEHICLE5 ,SUM(VEHICLE6) as VEHICLE6 ,SUM(VEHICLE7) as VEHICLE7 ,SUM(VEHICLE8) as VEHICLE8 ,SUM(VEHICLE9) as VEHICLE9 ,SUM(VEHICLE98) as VEHICLE98 ,SUM(VEHICLE99) as VEHICLE99  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s  LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ampurcodefull as ar_code,ampurname as ar_name,ampurcodefull as l_code FROM campur GROUP BY l_code ORDER BY l_code ) as ar ON left(s.areacode,4)=ar.l_code    INNER JOIN ( SELECT hoscode as hcode,chospital.* FROM chospital INNER JOIN cchangwat ON chospital.provcode=cchangwat.changwatcode WHERE chospital.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND chospital.hdc_regist=1 AND chospital.status ='1' AND (zonecode={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) GROUP BY hoscode ) h ON s.hospcode=h.hcode    LEFT JOIN ccmihosp sp ON sp.hcode=h.hoscode AND sp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode,2) not IN('99') AND b_year IN(SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1))  AND (h.provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (sp.splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep in ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep={{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or {{MINISTRY_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.hoscode={{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) GROUP BY concat(sp.hcode)

cup.query: SELECT ar_code as areacode,ar_name as areamame ,SUM(visit) as visit ,SUM(death) as death ,SUM(VEHICLE1) as VEHICLE1 ,SUM(VEHICLE2) as VEHICLE2 ,SUM(VEHICLE3) as VEHICLE3 ,SUM(VEHICLE4) as VEHICLE4 ,SUM(VEHICLE5) as VEHICLE5 ,SUM(VEHICLE6) as VEHICLE6 ,SUM(VEHICLE7) as VEHICLE7 ,SUM(VEHICLE8) as VEHICLE8 ,SUM(VEHICLE9) as VEHICLE9 ,SUM(VEHICLE98) as VEHICLE98 ,SUM(VEHICLE99) as VEHICLE99  FROM  {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT hoscode as ar_code,hosname as ar_name,chospital.* FROM chospital ) h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode     INNER JOIN cmastercup ON h.hoscode = cmastercup. hsub     LEFT JOIN ccmihosp AS sp ON sp.hcode = s.hospcode AND sp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode,2) not IN('99') AND b_year IN(SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1))   AND (h.provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}})     AND ( cmastercup.hmain = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} OR {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL' )     AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (sp.splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep in ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep={{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or {{MINISTRY_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.hoscode={{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) GROUP BY ar_code

tambon.query: SELECT ar_code as areacode,ar_name as areamame ,SUM(visit) as visit ,SUM(death) as death ,SUM(VEHICLE1) as VEHICLE1 ,SUM(VEHICLE2) as VEHICLE2 ,SUM(VEHICLE3) as VEHICLE3 ,SUM(VEHICLE4) as VEHICLE4 ,SUM(VEHICLE5) as VEHICLE5 ,SUM(VEHICLE6) as VEHICLE6 ,SUM(VEHICLE7) as VEHICLE7 ,SUM(VEHICLE8) as VEHICLE8 ,SUM(VEHICLE9) as VEHICLE9 ,SUM(VEHICLE98) as VEHICLE98 ,SUM(VEHICLE99) as VEHICLE99  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tamboncodefull as ar_code,tambonname as ar_name,tamboncodefull as l_code FROM ctambon GROUP BY l_code ORDER BY l_code) as ar ON left(s.areacode,6)=ar.l_code     LEFT JOIN chospital as h ON s.hospcode=h.hoscode    LEFT JOIN ccmihosp sp ON sp.hcode=h.hoscode AND sp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode,2) not IN('99') AND b_year IN(SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1))  AND (h.provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (sp.splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep in ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep={{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or {{MINISTRY_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.hoscode={{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) GROUP BY ar_code

service_plan_hospital.query: SELECT concat(h.splevel,'_',h.hcode) as areacode,ar_name as areamame ,SUM(visit) as visit ,SUM(death) as death ,SUM(VEHICLE1) as VEHICLE1 ,SUM(VEHICLE2) as VEHICLE2 ,SUM(VEHICLE3) as VEHICLE3 ,SUM(VEHICLE4) as VEHICLE4 ,SUM(VEHICLE5) as VEHICLE5 ,SUM(VEHICLE6) as VEHICLE6 ,SUM(VEHICLE7) as VEHICLE7 ,SUM(VEHICLE8) as VEHICLE8 ,SUM(VEHICLE9) as VEHICLE9 ,SUM(VEHICLE98) as VEHICLE98 ,SUM(VEHICLE99) as VEHICLE99  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ampurcodefull as ar_code,ampurname as ar_name,ampurcodefull as l_code FROM campur GROUP BY l_code ORDER BY l_code ) as ar ON left(s.areacode,4)=ar.l_code    INNER JOIN ( SELECT hcode as hospcode,hcode,splevel,chospital.* FROM ccmihosp INNER JOIN chospital ON ccmihosp.hcode=chospital.hoscode WHERE byear =SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}},',',-1) AND (splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (ccmihosp.region={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (ccmihosp.chwcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) GROUP BY hcode ) h ON s.hospcode=h.hospcode  WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode,2) not IN('99') AND b_year IN(SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1))     AND (h.provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep in ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep={{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or {{MINISTRY_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.hoscode={{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}='ALL') GROUP BY concat(h.splevel,'_',h.hcode)
